sites.name: Vat Phou
sites.what: Hillside Khmer temple complex and ancient settlement landscape (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.opening: Daily 8 am to 5 pm; museum 8 am to 4.30 pm. Early and late tickets sold 6 to 8 am and 4.30 to 6 pm.
access.tickets: Foreigners LAK 50,000 including museum and electric shuttle, valid all day; early or late entry LAK 55,000 (no RBA rate for the kip).

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.evidence: Official pages; read directly unless marked search snapshot.
